description: The WHEN MONTHLYI arm at :212-238 with CONFIRMI = 'Y' - the folder's canonical gate G42 rendering, where all seventeen eighty-byte records are written out in full rather than summarised (practice B8). The clock is pinned to 2022-07-15T10:30:45, an ordinary thirty-one day month, so :225 IF WS-CURDATE-MONTH > 12 takes its FALSE side: July plus one is August and no year roll-over runs, where case10 pins December and the TRUE side. The month end is not tabulated. :229-230 composes FUNCTION DATE-OF-INTEGER over FUNCTION INTEGER-OF-DATE minus one against the first day of the following month, so the day before 1 August 2022 is the thirty-first and the pair's whole meaning is 'the last day of the current month' (gate G29). The leap and common February forms of that same derivation are pinned mechanically by CORPT00CParityTest.TheDateIntrinsics.theMonthEndDerivation, so no fixture has to spend its scenario on them. MONTHLYI carries 'X' rather than 'Y': :213 reads MONTHLYI NOT = SPACES AND LOW-VALUES, so any non-blank value selects the arm, and a translation that had written an equality test against 'Y' fails here and only here. All ten xxxI items are declared, the nine others present and blank, which is what proves the ordered EVALUATE takes its FIRST true arm and that the six custom-date items are ignored on this path (gate G30). The unitKind is CONTROLLER_POJO: ReportRequestController is constructed as a plain object and called through mainPara - no MockMvc, no TestRestTemplate, no servlet container, no JobLauncher (gate G51) - and no dataset is seeded, because this program issues no file command at all. Java has no transient data queue, so EXEC CICS WRITEQ TD QUEUE('JOBS') at :517, reached through the paragraph the source misspells WIRTE-JOBSUB-TDQ at :515 and preserved with that spelling (practice B5), is reproduced through an explicit job-submission port: the transport is substituted, the content is not. Eighty bytes is app/csd/CARDDEMO.CSD:499-505's RECORDSIZE(80) RECORDFORMAT(FIXED) BLOCKFORMAT(UNBLOCKED) DISPOSITION(MOD) and :79's JCL-RECORD PIC X(80); the seventeen records and their order are the declaration order of 02 JOB-DATA-1 at :83-125 read through 02 JOB-DATA-2 REDEFINES it as JOB-LINES OCCURS 1000 TIMES PIC X(80) at :126-127. Both numbers are therefore derived mechanically rather than chosen, and the derivation is auditable from this file (practice B11); the one-based OCCURS subscript maps to the zero-based rowIndex below as n minus one. Rows 10 and 11 are 05 FILLER-1 and 05 FILLER-2 - an eighteen and a sixteen character prefix, the ten byte date, then a fifty-two and a fifty-four byte FILLER whose FIRST character is the closing quote, so a malformed line can still measure eighty bytes if the quote is appended instead. Row 16 is '/*EOF' and is present because :502-505 sets END-LOOP-YES and :507 writes anyway, making the sentinel itself the seventeenth record. ROW 14 IS THE CROSS-FOLDER CONTRACT: its leading twenty-one bytes, '2022-07-01 2022-07-31', ARE the DATEPARM record transaction.DateParmReader consumes at offsets 0:10/10:1/11:10/21:59 in eighty, the one place in this migration where an online screen's output is a batch program's input, and parity/CBTRN03C seeds that same line inline - this folder is its authoritative producer. app/proc/TRANREPT.prc's own STEP05R (SORT, SYMNAMES DD) and STEP10R (PGM=CBTRN03C, DATEPARM DD) are the step names rows 7 and 13 override, and row 5's PROC=TRANREPT resolves through the JCLLIB ORDER on row 3. On the success path :445-456 runs INITIALIZE-ALL-FIELDS, which blanks the ten items and WS-MESSAGE, then MOVE DFHGREEN TO ERRMSGC OF CORPT0AO - the ONLY colour assignment anywhere in this program, which is why ERRMSGC is pinned on the send and why no field is recoloured red or starred here (gate G38) - then STRING builds a forty-one character notice into WS-MESSAGE PIC X(80), and :560 moves it into ERRMSGO PIC X(78) so the two message channels differ by exactly the two bytes COBOL loses on the right. The IF NOT ERR-FLG-ON guard at :445 is effectively always true, because every SEND-TRNRPT-SCREEN ends GO TO RETURN-TO-CICS at :580 and never returns to its caller; it is preserved rather than tidied (practice B5). Titles come from app/cpy/COTTL01Y.cpy, whose line 21 is COMMENTED OUT, so TITLE02O is the CardDemo form and never 'Credit Card Demo Application (CCDA)'. Nothing is left to the wall clock and nothing is random (practice B7): 07/15/22 and 10:30:45 are the pinned instant read through WS-CURDATE-MM-DD-YY and WS-CURTIME-HH-MM-SS at :618-628 using WS-CURDATE-YEAR(3:2) at :620, and the code page is named US-ASCII rather than defaulted (practice B8). review_rules returns exactly one line, 'No user rules provided', so ZERO user rules govern this fixture and enterprise practices B1, B3, B5, B7, B8, B11 and B12 stand in their place; their absence is not licence to lower the bar. Every expected value here is STATICALLY DERIVED by reading app/cbl/CORPT00C.cbl against app/csd/CARDDEMO.CSD, app/jcl/TRANREPT.jcl, app/proc/TRANREPT.prc, app/cpy-bms/CORPT00.CPY, app/bms/CORPT00.bms, app/cpy/COTTL01Y.cpy, app/cpy/CSDAT01Y.cpy and app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy, every one of which is read-only reference (practice B3), and NEVER captured from a running COBOL program, which is impossible in this environment (risk R-A). DFHENTER and DFHGREEN come from common.CicsAid and common.BmsAttributes because DFHAID and DFHBMSCA are IBM-supplied and absent from this repository (risk R-D). No line below is a placeholder or an ellipsis standing in for content (practice B1).
